$comment: Launch gates as code (tracking: https://gitlab.com/authichain-group/authichain-unified/-/work_items/1987). Run by scripts/autonomy/launch-gates.mjs. FAIL CLOSED: a gate passes only with positive evidence. `pending` gates always FAIL until implemented. kill_switch=true stands the runner down (no probes, no issues). This file is a protected path (CODEOWNERS) so autonomous agents cannot edit their own gates.

promotion.$comment: Consumed by Gate 5 (not yet implemented). Order in which hosts go public; the next host is promoted when gates 1-4 stay green for green_window_hours.

gates.title: CI executes and is green (steps ran, not just 'no failures')
gates.evidence_required: Latest completed run per workflow on the default branch concluded success, has at least one job, and every job has executed steps.

gates.title: Public hosts reachable (no Cloudflare Access redirect)
gates.evidence_required: Every probe returned the expected status within budget with no redirect to the forbidden host.

gates.title: Signed verification round trip (issue, scan, verify) + /p timeout fix
gates.evidence_required: Test record issued, ES256 payload verified by authichain-verify and the public endpoint, tampered payload rejected.

gates.title: Checkout and Stripe webhook health (DPP Readiness)
gates.evidence_required: Test-mode checkout completes; webhook enabled with required events.

gates.title: Auto-promotion by host, auto-rollback, circuit breakers
gates.evidence_required: Rollback drill executed; breakers trip and re-arm.

gates.title: Estate reconciliation (KEEP/REPAIR/RETIRE for every Worker)
gates.evidence_required: Every live Worker has source or a classified inventory entry.

gates.title: Outreach compliance guardrails
gates.evidence_required: Suppression list, regional rules and breaker tested; gate decides whether cold_outreach may be enabled.

gates.title: Public trust artifacts (spec, open verifier, key registry, status page)
gates.evidence_required: Spec, verifier version, registry and status page published and reachable.

gates.title: Docs and backlog consolidation
gates.evidence_required: docs/operations consolidated, LAUNCH.md matches this manifest, link check green.
